instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: In just a few days, emergency evacuation centres were displaced in safer regions.
atoms.b: In just a few days, emergency ((evacuation)) centres were displaced in safer regions

atoms.a: Nobody believed it was their obligation to clean up the dog’s mess.
atoms.b: Nobody believed it was their ((obligation)) to clean up the dog’s mess.

atoms.a: The semi-colon is a less frequently used form of punctuation.
atoms.b: The semi-colon is a less frequently used form of ((punctuation)).

atoms.a: The acquisition of a new language is more easily achievable for children than for adults.
atoms.b: The ((acquisition)) of a new language is more easily achievable for children than for adults.

atoms.a: The mirage in the desert created an ((illusion)) of an oasis.
atoms.sound: The mirage in the desert created an illusion of an oasis.
atoms.b: The mirage in the desert created an ((illusion)) of an oasis.

atoms.a: There is a high correlation between high temperatures in summer and ice cream sales.
atoms.b: There is a high ((correlation)) between high temperatures in summer and ice cream sales.

parentBlock.title: Spelling Practice (22) - evacuation, obligation, punctuation, acquisition, illusion, correlation
